features.user_path: Blank cartridge -> title -> opening -> village -> cold Continue
features.expectation: Held buttons cannot skip story pages; only completion publishes a save; Continue restores the earned village

features.user_path: Walk or step near walls and corners in each region
features.expectation: Every accepted position is collision-free and steps stop at barriers

features.user_path: Equip a weapon -> combine upgrades -> attack across obstacles
features.expectation: Composed stats remain valid and projectiles cannot skip intervening walls

features.user_path: Use power, recall and companion-selection button sequences
features.expectation: Each input chord has one owner and cancelled actions do not leak into a power cast

features.user_path: Open journal -> browse with held and fresh directions -> return
features.expectation: Browsing cannot move the player or alter the saved adventure

features.user_path: Earn reward -> save -> interrupt any written byte -> reload
features.expectation: Reload yields a whole committed state; replay cannot duplicate XP, gear or rewards

features.user_path: Load an independently encoded starter save from each prior revision
features.expectation: Revisions 1 through 13 migrate without accepting impossible persistent states

features.user_path: Boot, read the opening, browse menus and move with music
features.expectation: Measured frames present within budget, audio has no faults and PCM copies preserve exact periodic samples

features.user_path: Enter each Return area -> approach exits, landmarks and trial targets
features.expectation: Every declared dynamic obstacle state preserves reachable required landing points and interaction approaches
